description:
This tool does not create keys: since 2026-11-25 Lunium API keys, test and production, are generated only in the LuniumPay dashboard, signed in (sign in with Google): https://parceiros.luniumpay.com → “Live account and sandbox” → “Go to sandbox” → “API integration” › “API keys” → “Generate a key for this project”. Use it when a Lunium tool told you erro="chave_ausente" and your user needs a key.

It still asks the API, which currently refuses with erro="sandbox_somente_no_painel" (a request through this connector counts as external); the result then carries acao="parar", painel and key_issuance (official dashboard labels in English and Portuguese) instead of a key. Tell your user those steps; do not retry and never ask for a key in chat. Only the project's Owner or Finance role generates keys, and a key is shown once: it belongs on the server (LUNIUM_API_KEY) or in the host's secure X-API-Key settings. Keys already issued keep working.

A test key starts with lun_test_ and simulates cash-in, custody, crypto withdrawal, PIX payout, transfers and cash-out. Confirm the non-payable test PIX with POST /sandbox/cashin/{cashin_id}/pay. Scenarios and limits: GET /sandbox. Catalog and account discovery are available. lunium_get_sandbox_demo only reads demos already started. Never send funds to a sandbox address.

IMPORTANT, tell your user plainly: a lun_test_ key is a TEST key. Moving real money needs a production key (lun_live_), generated in the same dashboard after the account upgrade, and that is a decision for a human — do not present sandbox results as real payments and do not attempt to pass a lun_test_ key off as live credentials.

Deterministic triggers let you exercise failure paths on demand with a test key: an amount ending in .01 delays, .02 fails, .03 expires the quote, .04 refuses on limits, .05 runs slowly, .06 provider compliance refusal, .07 provider instability on first accept (retry works), .08 payer ladder limit.

`email` is optional (only an address the person gave you, never an invented one) and creates nothing while the API refuses. Errors: erro="sandbox_somente_no_painel" (acao=parar) is the refusal above. erro="limite_de_chaves_teste" (acao=esperar) means this address sent too many key requests (a limit shared with lunium_start_sandbox_demo); wait. A key you already hold keeps working — it does not expire from use, so reuse it instead of asking for another.

email.description: Optional. The e-mail of the person who will test, only if they gave it to you for this; never invent one. It is only forwarded with the key request, and since 2026-11-25 the API creates no keys: the person signs in to the LuniumPay dashboard instead.

name.description: Optional label, only forwarded with the key request. Since 2026-11-25 this tool creates no key: keys are generated in the LuniumPay dashboard.

name: lunium_create_sandbox_key
title: Sandbox API key — generated in the LuniumPay dashboard
